verdict.rationale: Mastra persists workflow and agent execution state to storage. Snapshots capture everything needed to resume from exactly where a run left off, and suspended runs can pause indefinitely. Durable thread-scoped goals, PubSub-based reconnects, background tasks and cron schedules add long-running support. However, the evidence frames this as explicit suspend/resume rather than automatic recovery from crashes, restarts or deploys mid-run. Missing for 10: documented automatic crash/restart recovery of in-flight runs, durable-execution integrations (e.g., Temporal/Inngest-style engines), and independent hands-on corroboration of durability across deploys.
